# sec-filing-ingestion — Roadmap

## Outcomes

Source: your partner's words, 2026-11-06. Background: specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec.md, specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-adr.md.
Choices made: Python 3.14 in a uv workspace of four packages (sec-edgar-client, sec-edgar-download, sec-edgar-index-ingest, sec-edgar-ingest), from the repository scaffold.

| # | Outcome | Track | Rank | Cost (estimate; basis) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | The quarterly and daily index files, ingested into one filing-index table | A | 1 | Small: about 130 quarterly files since 1993 plus one daily file per business day, minutes of downloading at 3 requests/second; basis: the SEC full-index and daily-index directories. Measured by Stage 1 |
| O2 | The individual submissions that the index rows name, downloaded | A | 2 | Large: millions of files, weeks for the full history at 3 requests/second; basis: index row count times request rate, not yet measured. Measured per quarter by Stage 2 |
| O3 | 10-K and 8-K filings handled: picked out of the submissions, with their main documents extracted | A | 3 | Unknown until submissions are on disk; measured by Stage 3 |

Tracks: A — SEC filing ingestion (known progression). One track: each outcome consumes the one before it.

## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Filing-index table
      Objective: Ingest the real quarterly and daily index files into one filing-index table.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: nothing (package scaffolds only)
      Produces: a filing-index table on disk covering the quarterly indexes from 1993 through the latest closed quarter, plus the daily indexes since; a SEC client that sends an identifying User-Agent and stays under the request target; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: the table answers queries by CIK, form type and filing date across the whole range, with its row count recorded. The findings file records bytes downloaded, request count, achieved request rate and wall time of the real run.
      Leaves out: raw-snapshot retention and source manifest (Stage 4); quarterly reconciliation and versioned publication (Stage 5); shared request budget across concurrent collectors (Stage 6); golden-fixture validation suite (Stage 7); scheduled daily runs and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Submissions for one quarter
      Objective: Download every submission named by one real quarter's index rows.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 1's filing-index table and SEC client
      Produces: the submissions for one quarter on disk, addressable from their index rows; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-2-findings.md
      Exit: every submission named by the chosen quarter's index rows is on disk or listed as failed with a reason. The findings file records file count, bytes, wall time, achieved request rate and the projected full-history cost.
      Leaves out: full-history download and resumable checkpoints (Stage 6); raw-snapshot retention and manifest (Stage 4); validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: 10-K and 8-K handling for one quarter
      Objective: Pick the 10-K and 8-K filings, amendments included, out of Stage 2's submissions and extract their main documents.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 2's submissions on disk
      Produces: a list of the quarter's 10-K and 8-K filings, each linked to its extracted main document; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-3-findings.md
      Exit: every 10-K and 8-K in the quarter has an extracted main document or is listed as failed with a reason. The findings file records counts by form type, failure count and wall time.
      Leaves out: extraction over the full history (Stage 6); validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: Provenance and replay
      Objective: Retain original source bytes by content hash and record source, snapshot and processing state so that a parser change reprocesses stored inputs without new downloads.
      Outcomes: O1, O2
      Consumes: Stages 1–2's ingestion and download code
      Produces: hash-addressed raw storage and a source manifest that later stages read and write
      Exit: rerunning Stage 1's ingestion with a new parser version rebuilds the table from stored bytes with zero SEC requests. Every downloaded file has a manifest record naming its URL, hash and receipt time.
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Corrections and versioned publication
      Objective: Re-read quarterly indexes, record additions, changed fields and withdrawals, and publish each quarter as a complete generation behind one active pointer.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 4's raw storage and manifest
      Produces: per-quarter generations with change reports; an active pointer that readers resolve
      Exit: a re-read of a changed quarterly index yields a new generation with a change report, while the prior generation stays readable. A replacement that removes rows does not become active without a recorded approval.
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Full-history submissions and filings
      Objective: Run O2's downloads and O3's extraction over the full index history, resumably, under one shared SEC request budget.
      Outcomes: O2, O3
      Consumes: Stage 2's and Stage 3's findings (per-quarter cost); Stage 4's manifest
      Produces: all submissions and all extracted 10-K and 8-K main documents for the history, with per-quarter completion status
      Exit: every quarter is reported complete, or lists its unresolved files. An interrupted run resumes without redownloading completed files. Concurrent collectors never together exceed the request target.
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 7: Validation suite
      Objective: Cover index formats across the ingested range, malformed and HTML responses, and replay and recovery with committed fixtures and mocked SEC responses.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–6's code
      Produces: a CI suite that downloads nothing from the SEC
      Exit: CI passes on golden fixtures for every index format in the ingested range, and a malformed or HTML response fails closed in a test.
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 8: Scheduling and deployment
      Objective: Run daily ingestion and periodic reconciliation on a schedule in a deployed environment, with monitoring, alerts and runbooks.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stage 7's passing suite; Stages 4–6's manifest, publication and full-history runs
      Produces: deployed, scheduled operation
      Exit: two consecutive scheduled daily runs and one scheduled reconciliation complete, each with a durable run report. One induced failure raises an alert.
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming
